title: 第2514章 马失前蹄第2513章 礼义廉耻
slug: 给你玉女心经没让你用双修证道
content_zh:
陈玲儿本以为黄夜会一蹴而就，没想到这个过程很短暂。
两人纠缠在一起没一会儿，自己兴致正高的时候，却被这小子推开。
收到白秀秀和这小子各自进入自己房间、两人之前并不认识的消息。
已然断定白秀秀应该想拿下这小子，肯定没成功，自己还以为这小子是个正人君子，进门后才知道猜错了。
这明显是个老手，盘弄得极其到位，动作相当熟练。
如果两人继续下去，自己有把握做到事半功倍，结果却功亏一篑。
他到底要闹哪出，整个画面跟自己想象的完全不一样呢？
陈玲儿不解地看向黄夜。
“你别想多了，我只是告诉你，别跟我玩心眼，老子可不是什么善茬，老子说出在江湖上的名号能吓死你！”
黄夜露出色厉内荏的表情包，一脸凶巴巴的样子。
“我好怕怕啊，小兄弟什么名号啊？”
陈玲儿故意装出我见犹怜的样子。
“江湖人称辣手摧花小恶魔的便是小爷。”
黄夜杜撰了一个凶狠的名号。
“啊，你就是那个神挡杀神，佛挡杀佛的辣手摧花小恶魔。”
陈玲儿惊道，小脸满是惊恐之色。
黄夜不禁一怔，卧槽，不会真有这人吧。
小黄眼看到陈玲儿眼中那丝狡黠的目光，黄夜不得不佩服，这妞的戏路也很宽，绝对是高手。
如果在现代，什么奥斯卡小金人，金鸡、百花、金鹰、金熊能拿到手软。
“小妮子别以为我胡说八道，死在老子手下的女人不计其数。”

“你可拉倒吧，真以为我是什么都不懂的雏，老娘好歹也在混迹江湖多年，真正的杀神什么样，老娘心里有数。”
陈玲儿撇了撇小嘴。
“你懂个毛线，自己动手杀人的都是蠢货，借刀杀人才是高手。”
“说吧，找我有什么事儿？”
黄夜直接切入主题。
“没什么事，就想过来和你欢好一下。”
“那你可以走了，我们已经欢好完毕，慢走不送。”
黄夜大手一挥，房门已然开启。
“我就这么不招人待见！”
陈玲儿白了黄夜一眼，小手一挥，房门又关上了。
“没什么待不待见，我们本就不是一路人，有句话你应该听过，道不同不相为谋。”
“在我的认知里，女人只会影响我拔刀的速度，所以你不用跟我玩什么套路，本少不吃你那套。”
“以小爷的本事和财力，什么样的女人得不到？”
黄夜虚构了一个人设。
“你厉害还不行吗？行了，老娘也不跟你绕弯子，我找你确实有事，我想跟你谈谈合作。”
陈玲儿直接摊牌。
“合作，你觉得有资格和我谈合作吗？本少眼里可容不得沙子。”
content_en:
Chen Ling'er thought that Huang Ye would be successful overnight, but she didn't expect that the process would be short.
The two of them were entangled together for a while. When I was in high spirits, I was pushed away by this kid.
I received the news that Bai Xiuxiu and this boy entered their own rooms respectively, and they did not know each other before.
He had already concluded that Bai Xiuxiu wanted to capture this boy, but he definitely failed. He thought that this boy was a gentleman, but he realized that he was wrong after he entered the house.
This is obviously an experienced player, he is very good at handling and his movements are quite skillful.
If the two of them continued, they were sure that they would get twice the result with half the effort, but in the end they fell short.
What exactly was he trying to cause trouble? Was the whole scene completely different from what he had imagined?
Chen Ling'er looked at Huang Ye in confusion.
"Don't think too much. I'm just telling you, don't play tricks on me. I'm not a good person. I can scare you to death if I tell you my name in the world!"
Huang Ye showed a fierce expression with a fierce look on his face.
"I'm so scared. What's your little brother's name?"
Chen Ling'er deliberately pretended to feel pity for me.
"The man who people in the world call the little devil who can destroy flowers is the young master."
Huang Ye made up a fierce name.
"Ah, you are the devil who kills gods when God blocks him, and kills flowers when Buddha blocks Buddha."
Chen Ling'er said in shock, her little face full of horror.
Huang Ye couldn't help but be startled. Damn it, this person couldn't really exist.
Xiao Huangyan saw the cunning look in Chen Ling'er's eyes, and Huang Ye had to admire her. This girl also had a wide range of acting skills, and she was definitely a master.
If in modern times, Oscar statuettes such as Golden Rooster, Hundred Flowers, Golden Eagle and Golden Bear could be obtained with mercy.
"Little girl, don't think I'm talking nonsense. Countless women have died at my hands."
"You can pull me down. You really think that I am a ignorant person. After all, I have been wandering around the world for many years. I know what the real God of Death is like."
Chen Ling'er curled her lips.
"You know what you're talking about. Anyone who kills someone by himself is an idiot, but someone who kills someone with a borrowed knife is a master."
"Tell me, what do you want from me?"
Huang Ye got straight to the point.
"Nothing, I just wanted to come over and have some fun with you."
"Then you can leave. We have finished having fun, so we can go slowly without seeing you off."
Huang Ye waved his hand and the door was already opened.
"I'm so unpopular!"
Chen Ling'er rolled her eyes at Huang Ye, waved her hand, and closed the door again.
"There is no need to wait or see. We are not from the same place. There is a saying that you should have heard: people who are different from each other do not work together."
"In my opinion, women can only affect the speed at which I draw my sword, so you don't need to play any tricks with me. I won't accept your tricks."
"With my ability and financial resources, what kind of woman can't get it?"
Huang Ye made up a fictional character.
"You're awesome, aren't you? Okay, I won't beat around the bush with you. I really have something to do with you, and I want to talk to you about cooperation."
Chen Ling'er directly showed her cards.
"Cooperation, do you think you are qualified to discuss cooperation with me? I can't tolerate sand in my eyes."
